context: Sho-young brings home a science kit; Kenji helps him with an experiment.
purpose: Father figure helping child with hands-on learning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 健司おじちゃん、実験しよ!
lines.style: Bright, quick attack on the opening excitement. Small-boy enthusiasm without shouting. Warm and trusting—he knows Kenji will say yes. Breathless slightly, the energy of an idea just occurred to him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Soft, immediate response. Warm curiosity—not humoring but genuinely interested in what's on the kid's mind. Slight upward lift at the end, inviting him to explain. Kansai lilt sits gently underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Will water and oil mix together?
lines.style: Soft, observant question. Not demanding an answer—testing the idea out loud, checking if Kenji thinks it's possible. Hopeful undertone, a little unsure of himself but wanting to believe in the experiment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 道具揃えて、やってみよか。
lines.en: Let's find the stuff and give it a try.
lines.style: Patient, practical. Low, steady voice—the tone of an adult who's done this before and is setting the scene for the child. Gentle encouragement folded into the logistics. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Unbridled delight in small-boy pitch. Quick, bright, alive. The joy is simple and complete—not performing it, actually feeling it. Sharp on the 'yeah,' trailing warmth on 'fun.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Playful, knowing warmth. Kansai rhythm underlying. Slight tease in the suggestion—the promise of discovery without over-promising. Conspiratorial—he and Sho are partners in this.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Peak bright energy. Fast-paced, infectious excitement. The word 'yes' carries all the relief and delight of permission. Breathless and open-mouthed on the excitement trailing through 'excited.'
